title: A ZeroBounce-valid email at another company is the wrong person
hypothesis: A valid verifier status means the right contact.
change: Checked each found email's domain against the brand and parent domains, retrying the runner-up when off-domain.
result: Gymshark's search returned a Social Media Ambassador whose email was at buckedup.com, and ZeroBounce called it valid. With the domain check and one runner-up retry, Gymshark, Celsius and Barebells all ended on valid on-domain buyers. Ruled 2026-10-16 (Caleb, 'do wtv is best'): a catch-all or unknown verdict doesn't count as verified either.
next_decision: The chain retries the runner-up on catch-all or unknown too, keeps a catch-all pick only as 'catch-all, unverified, send after the valid ones', and calls gtme_lessons.verified_email so chain and oracle can't drift (sent to the live_chain session 2026-10-16).
check: Run `chewbacca gtme lesson verified-email` on every found email before spending on outreach.
scope: Brand contacts found by people search plus Findymail.
